title: Merge two sorted lists
statement: Merge two sorted linked lists by splicing their nodes; return the head of the merged sorted list.
hints: A dummy head node removes the special case for the first node.

solution.explanation: A dummy node and a tail pointer: repeatedly attach the smaller head and advance; attach the remainder at the end. The dummy-head trick removes every "is the result empty?" branch.
solution.python:
def merge_two(a, b):
    dummy = tail = ListNode()
    while a and b:
        if a.val <= b.val: tail.next, a = a, a.next
        else: tail.next, b = b, b.next
        tail = tail.next
    tail.next = a or b
    return dummy.next
